about_the_game:
Welcome to The Adventures of Caine McDowell:

Step into the shoes of the ruggedly handsome, morally questionable space pilot, Caine McDowell, in his quest to escape from a planet full of alien monsters and Space Raiders, all while being endlessly pursued by the unstoppable bounty hunter, Porksley! Tap into your pilot intuition and strap yourself in, this is gonna be a bumpy ride!

"Adventures of Caine McDowell" acts as a love letter to classic point-and-click adventure games, combining a witty, sci-fi aesthetic with polished, action-packed gameplay to create an epic experience for both newcomers and longstanding fans of the puzzle-adventure genre!

Features:

  • Mind-boggling puzzles with multiple solutions that have an impact on the rest of the game

  • Heart-racing action

  • Integration of modern controls for mouse and keyboard (Controller integration coming soon!)

  • A colorful, retro, pixel-art aesthetic

  • Multiple endings (and even a secret one don't tell anybody ;] )

  • A minimalist HUD system to ensure maximum immersion

  • And so much more!

This Game is Still a Work-In-Progress!

Be aware that the gameplay footage shown in the trailer as well as the screenshots are of a fairly early version of the game. While the art style, mechanics, and general gameplay and aesthetic will not be changed, certain levels, puzzles, animations, and scenes shown may not be exactly the same in the final product. I will make sure to regularly update the storefront in order to better depict these changes as they arise.

Hope to see you among the stars!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent with OpenGL 2.1 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD Graphics 4000 or Apple Silicon GPU (Metal supported)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

name: Adventures of Caine McDowell: The Porkian Encounter

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 v1803 x64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
